settings.title: AI Service Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure Base URL, API Key, and LLM Model for AI evaluation

browserBridge.title: Browser Bridge
browserBridge.description: Optional: connects the FocusStudy extension (Chrome/Edge) so the tracker sees the real active tab. Only tab titles and hostnames are transmitted.
browserBridge.errors: Bridge executable is missing — reinstall the app.
browserBridge.step1: Load this folder (browser-extension) unpacked in edge://extensions or chrome://extensions with Developer mode on.
browserBridge.step2: Open the extension popup and copy the extension ID.
browserBridge.step3: Paste the ID above and save. The app registers the native host automatically.
browserBridge.step4: Restart the browser, then press "Test native host connection" in the popup.
browserBridge.step5: Done — tab switches now appear as real tab titles in the tracker.

settings.searchHint: Let the AI search the web when it needs current or unknown information (e.g. homework questions). Uses the search_web tool with DuckDuckGo locally, or google_search grounding on Google-hosted endpoints.
settings.noAiKeyHintDesc: Add an API key above to enable AI environment audits, distraction justifications, and web search.
settings.privacyHint: Only unknown app names, window titles, and hostnames are sent for review. Page bodies, cookies, and full URL paths are never sent.
settings.secureKeyHint: The API key is protected with Windows OS-backed encryption when available.
